objective: Make Cloud IaC provider dependency locking a first-class fail-closed local Oya gate by adding a dedicated OpenTofu lock root outside reusable modules, committing a multi-platform .terraform.lock.hcl for the provider-readiness families, and validating manifest/readiness/providers.tofu/lockfile coherence while preserving no provider installation, configuration, API, provenance, signing, SLSA, plan/apply, state backend, provider-resource-complete, or cloud provisioning claims.

best_practice_sources.evidence_used: providers.tofu declares explicit provider source addresses and reusable-module-compatible minimum constraints for the families inventoried by provider-readiness.
The lockfile is treated as reviewable dependency-selection evidence and is committed separately from any provider installation cache.
The provider lockfile was generated with explicit darwin_arm64, linux_amd64, and linux_arm64 platforms to pre-populate platform checksums.
Provider version requirements are centralized in a dedicated lock root rather than pretending generic reusable module skeletons contain provider resources/configuration.
SLSA provenance and verification summaries remain explicit future non-claims; this ChangeSet only records local lockfile evidence.
